body:
A Codex work run sometimes starts without the `solace` MCP tool in its tool list, so the agent can do nothing and exits.

**Seen in** task:d55c1a70adf88be3, run `a219a34c96ad6bc6` (model `commandcode-deepseek-v4.1-flash`): the agent only had `list_mcp_resources` / `read_mcp_resource` / `list_mcp_resource_templates`. Those calls reached `solace mcp` (it answered `-32601 method not found`, since it serves tools only), so the server was running and connected; the tool itself just wasn't offered to the model. The next run, `2062ff989e85ef1c`, with the same model, got the tool and worked normally. The run was reported only as "agent exited without finishing (exit status: 0)", plus an unrelated model-metadata warning.

**Needed**
- Find out why Codex sometimes leaves the tool out (for example, how Codex exposes MCP tools to a model that has no metadata, given the features `lockdown.agent_config` turns off), and fix it so a worker reliably gets the tool.
- If the agent ends without ever making a solace call, the run's outcome says plainly that the agent didn't get the Solace tool, instead of the generic "exited without finishing".

**Check:** a test covers the outcome message for a run that made no solace call.
title: board: Codex worker sometimes lacks Solace tool
